# An android field commits through its own path: the focus leaving it, and an
# input's keyboard Done, each committing only an edit made since the last
# commit. A test moves the focus to another field and presses the keyboard's
# action, as a user does. Only android, whose commit is this path; the change
# trigger every target answers is program_write_fires_no_event_runs.txt's.

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var memo = ""
    var away = ""
    var changes = 0

    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #field(:value=text, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        ui.textarea #notes(:value=memo, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        ui.input #other(:value=away)
        ui.button #set(text="set", @click {
            text = "abc"
            memo = "abc"
        })
    }
}

func testFocusNoEditBlurFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    c.notes.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testFocusEditBlurFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.notes.focus()
    c.notes.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 2)
}

func testProgramWriteThenBlurFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.set.click()
    c.other.focus()
    c.notes.focus()
    c.set.click()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.text == "abc")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testDoneThenBlurFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testDoneUneditedFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.submit()
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
